chapters.title: RISK HIGH
chapters.text: The rally takes MACD-V to 155, past +150 into the shaded risk band: the ribbon turns RISK HIGH. A leg beyond +50 is what a later cross needs to count as a setup.

chapters.title: BEAR SETUP
chapters.text: Out of a leg that took MACD-V to 170, the MACD crosses below its signal and the histogram grows on the next bar: the BEAR SETUP, marked M at the high.

chapters.title: CENTERLINE DOWN
chapters.text: MACD-V goes back through zero downward (now -1): the fast EMA has crossed the slow one, graded by the leg it left, which reached beyond ±50.

chapters.title: REVERSING
chapters.text: MACD-V passes -50 (now -55) with the histogram still below zero: the ribbon reads REVERSING.
